Let's use loops to make the elephant do a bunch of cool things!

1. When the number 1 is pressed, make the elephant grow 10 times. (In other words, make the elephant change its size by 10, repeated 10 times!)
2. When the number 2 is pressed, make the elephant shrink 10 times.
3. When the number 3 is pressed, make the elephant change color forever.
4. When the number 4 is pressed, make the elephant change a different effect forever.
5. When the number 5 is pressed, make the elephant repeatedly hide, wait for 1 second, and reappear.
6. When the space bar is pressed, make the elephant switch costumes, make a sound, and switch back to the normal costume for a second. Repeat this 3 times!
